name: tbe47f37c
say: The road to go-live. Five steps take us to lift-off on Monday 1 February 2027, with support continuing after go-live. Select a step to see what it means for you and the materials that support it.

name: tc8c3e7bd
say: Step 1, Keep your skills sharp. 26 October, 23 December 2026. Regular practice, so everyone is confident on Corbit X before go-live. What to focus on: Practise twice a week, every week; Branches: 7:15, 8:15 am. Departments: one hour, two days a week; Final session: Wednesday 23 December.

name: t51a6034c
say: Step 2, Rest and recharge. 24 December 2026, 3 January 2027. A break to celebrate with your loved ones. There are no scheduled sessions. What to focus on: No scheduled sessions; Celebrate with your loved ones; The Corbit X portal stays open if you want a refresher.

name: te16774f0
say: Step 3, Get go-live ready. 4, 22 January 2027. One hour every working day (15 days): a refresher, then certification for your role. What to focus on: Branches: 7:15, 8:15 am. Departments: time set by your HoD; Complete your refresher, then get certified by 22 January; Champions check in on your practice; Branch Operations Supervisors, BSSMs and HoDs make sure every session happens.

name: tbee58b15
say: Step 4, Final systems check. 11, 17 January 2027. Before lift-off, we make sure every record lands safely in Corbit X. Then we fly a full practice mission together on Sunday 17 January. What to focus on: Monday 11 January: static data migration; Wednesday 13, Friday 15 January: data validation. Saturday 16 January: financial validation; Sunday 17 January: business simulation (migration plus a full day of business replay).

name: t1042e237
say: Step 5, Lift-off weekend. Friday 29 January, Monday 1 February 2027. Friday 29 January is the last day on the current system, with a 2:00pm cut-off. Sunday 31 January is the live-check day. Monday 1 February is go-live. What to focus on: Friday 29 January: finish all transactions by 2:00pm, balance cash and vault, run the final end of day; Sunday 31 January: Branch Operations Supervisors open the branch day and all staff run live checks with real funds. Do not close the day or run end of day; Monday 1 February: arrive by 7:00am, log in, check printers and apps, welcome every customer and run end of day at close of business.

name: t726a62a6
say: After go-live, After go-live. From Monday 1 February 2027. Support for customers and colleagues through the first days, weeks and months. What to focus on: Monday 1, Wednesday 3 February: start account openings in Newgen. Accounts are finalised from Thursday 4 February; First weeks: hypercare, with daily check-ins, the Command Centre on call and champions on the floor; Old-number cheques are accepted until 2 August 2027, and old account numbers are still accepted.

name: t398fc906
say: Frequently asked question. When does Corbit X go live? Corbit X goes live on Monday 1 February 2027, in every branch and department at the same time. The final cut-off on the current system is Friday 29 January at 2:00pm.

name: t3e428ac6
say: Frequently asked question. Will customers' old account numbers still work after go-live? Yes. Old account numbers will continue to be accepted for more than six months after go-live. The new account number has 13 digits, and the C I F gains “00” in front. Look up the new number in Corbit X using the process covered in training, serve the customer, and share the new number so they use it next time.

name: t44665e72
say: Frequently asked question. Can customers still use cheques that show their old account number? Yes, for six months (182 days) after go-live, until 2 August 2027, subject to the usual checks. After that date these cheques will no longer be accepted, so encourage customers to request new chequebooks early.

name: t3ddb80b5
say: Frequently asked question. What about chequebooks recorded more than five years ago? These chequebooks will not be migrated to Corbit X and can no longer be used. Affected customers have been notified. Explain the position with care, help them access funds through an approved alternative, and assist with a new chequebook where required.

name: t656a5d7
say: Frequently asked question. Can we open new accounts during the upgrade? Account opening is unavailable in Flexcube 11.1 and Corbit X during the static data freeze (the week before go-live) and for the first three days after go-live (Monday 1 to Wednesday 3 February). Start the application in Newgen, receive deposits through the designated G L, and finalise from Thursday 4 February. Never turn a customer away.

name: t529f33e9
say: Frequently asked question. What happens on the Sunday before go-live? On Sunday 31 January 2027, Branch Operations Supervisors will open the branch day and all branch staff take part in live transaction and channel checks: deposits, branch transactions, ATMs, the mobile app and other instructed channels. These are real transactions with real funds. Do not close the branch day or run end of day on Sunday; continue into Monday and run end of day at close of business.

name: t396f8c18
say: Frequently asked question. What should I do if I'm not sure how to answer a customer? Pause and check before answering. Consult the relevant internal team, or find the guidebook or procedure in the repository. Never let a system change become a reason to turn a customer away.

name: t4258d4d2
say: Frequently asked question. Will new account numbers be printed for customers? Guidance on printing new account numbers will follow. Until then, look up and share the new number at every interaction.

name: t8a8fd59b
say: Frequently asked question. How do I read the new account number? It has 13 digits. Digits 1 and 2 are the currency (00 cedi, 01 dollar, 02 pound, 03 euro). Digit 3 is the customer type (1 individual, 2 non-individual, 3 banks and others). Digits 4 to 11 are a serial number, and digits 12 and 13 are check digits. Always add “00” in front of an existing C I F.

name: t5e3fb072
say: Frequently asked question. What should I do if I'm stuck? Check the repository guide or F A Q, then ask your champion or team lead. If you are still stuck, log a Command Centre ticket with a screenshot, and update the customer while you wait.

name: tbade79db
say: Frequently asked question. What if someone asks a customer for their OTP? The bank never asks for a PIN, password or OTP, and you must never share your login. Tell the customer, and report anything suspicious to Fraud and Risk.
